subject.title: feat: add Pioneer.ai as an inference provider with live model discovery

question: Should OpenClaw officially own and publish the Pioneer provider, or should Pioneer remain a community-owned npm/ClawHub plugin with any missing generic catalog seam reviewed separately?
rationale: Code review cannot decide who owns the official package namespace, provider support contract, dependency authorization, credential-routing policy, and future API compatibility.

options.title: Use community plugin plus core seam
options.body: Keep the Pioneer package outside this repository and submit only a narrow generic core/API change if the current external-provider catalog contract is insufficient.

options.title: Sponsor the official provider
options.body: A maintainer accepts long-term package and release ownership, approves the dependency graph, and requests a rebase onto current-main catalog APIs with fresh upgrade proof.

options.title: Pause pending an owner
options.body: Leave the PR open without merging until Pioneer or an OpenClaw maintainer commits to ownership and maintenance expectations.

recommendation.title: Use community plugin plus core seam
recommendation.body: Keep the Pioneer package outside this repository and submit only a narrow generic core/API change if the current external-provider catalog contract is insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice concerns official provider catalog inclusion, package ownership, and release policy rather than a mechanical implementation repair.
